requiredSectionHints: Selector in priority order: [data-test] > id > name > ARIA role > stable class
Relative URL path for precondition (never https://...)
Custom command to use (cy.login(), cy.safeVisit(), cy.apiRequest())
Any cy.intercept() requirements for network assertions

mandatoryRules: File MUST use describe() / it() structure
All navigation MUST use cy.safeVisit() — cy.visit() is FORBIDDEN and CI-linted
All HTTP requests MUST use cy.apiRequest() — cy.request() is FORBIDDEN and CI-linted
Every it() block MUST contain at least one .should() / expect() / cy.should() assertion
No hardcoded credential strings in .type() — use (Cypress.env('username') as string | undefined) ?? 'standard_user'
No it.skip() or xit() without a // @skip-reason: <explanation> comment
File MUST contain at least one cy.log() call
cy.log() calls MUST annotate major action blocks and assertions
If cy.fixture() or .selectFile('cypress/fixtures/...') is used, line 3 MUST have: // @requiredFixtures: [...]
cy.safeVisit() MUST use relative paths — never absolute URLs in safeVisit
Authentication MUST use cy.login() or cy.session() before visiting protected routes
Each it() MUST have an AC traceability comment above it (e.g. // AC-1: ...)
Iframe interactions MUST use cy.withinIframe() — never raw .its('contentDocument.body')
Non-UI ACs MUST produce a notimplemented stub — never silently skip

customCommandDocs.cy.login(): Built-in — uses Cypress.env('username') ?? 'standard_user' with safe defaults
customCommandDocs.cy.safeVisit(): Built-in — adds failOnStatusCode:false and logs landed URL
customCommandDocs.cy.withinIframe(): Built-in — wraps iframe interaction to avoid raw DOM access
